👮 Criminal Justice & Policing
MI SB 1133 — Michigan State Police Retirees Could Get Bigger Checks

This bill would change how the state calculates the retirement allowance for Michigan State Police officers. Specifically, it adjusts the timeframe used to determine ‘final average compensation’ – the key figure used to calculate benefits. For officers hired after June 10, 2012, the bill expands the period considered to five years of salary, instead of the current two. ...
